title: fix(gate): judge an emitted template against its reader's own manifest
body:
Fixes #8397

## The premise fork, measured first

The card made the deliverable conditional on a feasibility question nobody had answered: *"the census substitutes holes before compiling, and `buildPackageJson` returns an object, not a template literal"*.

**It CAN.** Measured before any edit, on `324b1d0684`, by parsing `packages/create-plugin/src/templates.ts` with the very `ts.createSourceFile` call the census already makes on that file:

```
LEG 1a — same-file object-literal consts: DEV_DEPENDENCIES, DEPENDENCIES
LEG 1b — manifest-shaped object literals found:
  templates.ts (buildPackageJson):
    dependencies      @object-ui/components, @object-ui/core, @object-ui/react, @object-ui/types
    devDependencies   @testing-library/jest-dom, @testing-library/react, @vitejs/plugin-react,
                      jsdom, typescript, vite, vite-plugin-dts, vitest
    peerDependencies  react, react-dom
```

An object literal is read by the same AST walk that finds the template literals beside it. Nothing has to be executed, transpiled or imported. ⇒ the fork takes the **CAN** branch.

## My own first reading of the three sites (on today's tip, not the card's table)

The card's coordinates are from 2026-09-08 and had drifted. Re-located by content on `324b1d0684`:

| builder | card said | today | census verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `buildVitestSetup` | `:314` | `:331` | `[bound]` refuses `@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest` |
| `buildTestFile` | `:491` | `:528` | `[bound]` refuses `@testing-library/react`, `vitest` |
| `buildViteConfig` | `:270` | `:287` | `[semantic]` TS2307 on `vite-plugin-dts` |

⭐ One thing the card did not record: the third was **the whole of the census's `code` class that run**. The single diagnostic the summary calls *"the only ones that say anything about the emitted code"* was an artefact of reading the wrong manifest.

## What lands

The bound's sentence is *"this specifier reaches the snippet only through this workspace's own installation, not through anything the emitted file's reader installs"*. For a document that is total. For a **generator** its premise can be false, because the same generator also writes the manifest the reader installs. The census now reads that manifest.

Three properties keep it a narrowing of the bound's **premise** rather than a hole in the bound:

1. **Read, not executed.** `scanEmittedManifests` reads a manifest-shaped object literal (`name` + `version` + a dependency field) out of the AST, following spreads of constants the emitting **package** declares exactly once. Narrow in the safe direction: a literal it misses costs a refusal (the status quo); a literal it wrongly admitted would widen the bound.
2. **Per emitting package, never merged.** `create-plugin`'s manifest says nothing about what a `packages/cli` template's reader installs. One merged map would have silenced a TS2307 in another generator's template — the same failure being fixed, one level up. The map is keyed by `packages/NAME` and applied per block, at the bound **and** at the resolver.
3. **Mapped only at an identical declared range.** A specifier is mapped to the types this workspace resolves for a manifest declaring that same specifier at that same range string — root or workspace package, tried root-first then by name. A range this repository does not itself declare stays unresolvable and is **printed**. So the census can never judge a template against a version its reader will not install, and a drift removes the mapping instead of lying.

The census also now runs the **ROOT-DECLARED control** in its own program, because the emitted-manifest map is the one thing that could widen the bound out from under it.

## The before/after pair

```
before   Judged 17 of 20 recognised template(s) ... 1 failed to parse, 2 were refused by the root bound.
         Of which 11 sibling, 4 interpolated. 1 remain [ = vite-plugin-dts TS2307 ]

after    Judged 19 of 20 recognised template(s) ... 1 failed to parse, 0 were refused by the root bound.
         Of which 11 sibling, 5 interpolated. 0 remain
```

## Proof that nothing was removed from what is compiled

⛔ The card's standing fence: *a change that improves the number by shrinking what is measured is the defect, not the fix.* Every measured population is **identical** before and after; the only count that moved is `judged`, and it moved **up**:

```
  Walked        1444 source file(s) ... 2780 excluded as TOOLING_FILE      (identical)
  Recognised    20 of 4056 template literal(s): 20 by heuristic, 0 marker  (identical)
  Blind side    0 marker template(s); 5 unrecognised module-shaped         (identical)
  Judged        17 -> 19          two blocks JOINED the semantic program
```

The two previously-refused blocks are now compiled and judged; one of them promptly produced a new diagnostic (`buildTestFile`'s `./__hole__Impl`, classified `interpolated`), which is what more measurement looks like.

The bound is proved still on **in the same program**:

```
  Bound live    the ROOT-DECLARED control ('vitest', covered by no global paths entry) produced
                1 diagnostic(s) (TS2307) in this same program — the root bound is ON for every
                block no emitted manifest speaks for.
```

That line is not decoration: `vitest` is exactly one of the specifiers a `create-plugin` block legitimately resolves in that run through its reader's own manifest. Both facts hold at once, or the map would be an exemption wearing a rule's clothes.

## What the census now says it cannot type

Reported line by line rather than assumed, every run:

```
  Reader's mfst 2 manifest(s) the generators themselves write: 18 specifier(s) mapped at the SAME
                range, 3 left unresolvable, 2 entry(s) unreadable, 8 constant name(s) ambiguous.
                ⚠ packages/create-plugin emits `jsdom`@^30.0.1 and it ships no types here
                ⚠ packages/create-plugin emits `react`@^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0 and no manifest here declares that range
                ⚠ packages/create-plugin emits `react-dom`@^18.0.0 || ^19.0.0 and no manifest here declares that range
```

`packages/cli`'s emitted manifest reaches the reader through a helper call (`platformPackageRange()`), so two of its entries are unreadable and reported instead of guessed.

## Reverse verification

The range-equality anchor was ablated on the committed tree (`filter((d) => d.range === range)` made unsatisfiable), the mutation proved on disk by counting both the removed and the injected text, and the restore proved by blob hash against `HEAD`:

```
ANCHOR before: original=1  mutated=0
ANCHOR after : original=0  mutated=1
  Reader's mfst ... 0 specifier(s) mapped ..., 21 left unresolvable
  Judged        17 of 20 ... 2 were refused by the root bound.
  Of which      ... 1 remain
RESTORE OK: a984be9f4e2f2d3214c70c754a8241e1e6a00a5e == HEAD blob a984be9f4e2f2d3214c70c754a8241e1e6a00a5e
```

The reading returns exactly to the pre-change one, so the new mapping — not an exclusion — is what moved the numbers.

## Gates

| gate | exit |
|:--|:--|
| `node scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` (documentation verdict) | 0, and **byte-identical** to the same command on the base script |
| `node scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs --emit-census` | 0 |
| `vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-doc-snippet-emitted-census.test.ts` | 0 — 39 passed (14 new) |
| `vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-doc-snippet-types.test.ts` | 0 — 107 passed |
| `pnpm lint:root` | 0 — 0 errors, 32 pre-existing warnings |
| `eslint` on the two changed files, `--format json` | 0 — 0 errors, 0 warnings |
| `check-changeset-presence` / `check-changeset-no-major` | 0 / 0 |
| `check-control-bytes`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-test-path-roots`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-readme-exports` | 0 |
| `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` | 0 — **0** new citations (the first draft added 5; they are now cited by builder name, which is the same drift this card burned a cycle on) |

The documentation run was compared by running the **base** copy of the script and diffing the output: identical apart from the lock wrapper's own wall-clock line.

`check-node-esm-load` exits 1 in this container for a reason outside this diff — turbo's shared cache replayed ten packages built in sibling worktrees (`objectui-issue-9124`, `objectui-issue-7848`), and the gate refuses to grade another tree's artifacts. This PR changes no package source; CI installs and builds fresh.

## Scope

`scripts/` only, plus an empty-frontmatter changeset (nothing published moves). ⛔ No test skipped, disabled or quarantined; ⛔ no threshold, floor or ratchet lowered; ⛔ no exemption widened. Draft, not enqueued.
